items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee discusses Lucille only in the context of her being a friend of a third party ('she was a great friend of Lucille's') and does not describe a direct personal relationship with Lucille.

ctx.x: I know it was a very interesting relationship because she's good friends with Lucille.

Oh, yeah, she's a good -- right, right, she was a great friend of Lucille's, but she still -- and she always talked about Louis and their association and their marriage and all of this, and Louis just could do no wrong. And then whenever he would come -- like he was here at Revenue one year, and so she went up and she just a ball with him. Oh, Pops, you're crazy.
